what: Chart bars: horizontal bars grow from zero one after another, values counting; the highlighted bar lands last in the accent; the source stays on screen
title: Hours a day on the phone
intent: Make one comparison land honestly: the highlighted value against the rest
action: Bars grow from a zero baseline in a cascade while their values count up; the highlighted bar lands last in red with a punch, the others step back; a sheen crosses it and the grid drifts while it holds; the source sits at the bottom
make_it_yours: Edit data.json: title, unit, decimals, source, highlight (a label) and up to eight bars. The title from --title is used only when data.json has none.
craft_note: One comparison per chart: the highlight is the payoff. Bars start at zero and stay proportional; the count never overshoots. The source is part of the picture.
look: Editorial data: near-black, warm white, one red bar
